subject: I need to tell you something
body:
You went to Cavaryn. On purpose. Through a termite.

I haven't been honest with you. I'm not busy, and the door isn't stuck. I'm scared of ants. Properly scared. Elythia is nice and all, but yeah I'm stuck. I just woke up here, and it's full of ants. I haven't been outside since I got here. Grim goes out for me.

So that's why it's been you out there instead of me. Sorry! :)

Your old friend,
Dr. T
